common_feature_contract.source_timeframe: M15 Bid OHLC reconstructed from Dukascopy Tick
common_feature_contract.atr16: rolling arithmetic mean of TR over 16 observed bars
common_feature_contract.atr20: rolling arithmetic mean of TR over 20 observed bars
common_feature_contract.atr96: rolling arithmetic mean of TR over 96 observed bars
common_feature_contract.median_tr96: rolling median of TR over 96 observed bars
common_feature_contract.ema20: pandas ewm(span=20, adjust=false).mean on observed Bid close
common_feature_contract.ema96: pandas ewm(span=96, adjust=false).mean on observed Bid close
common_feature_contract.mean32: rolling mean of Bid close over 32 observed bars
common_feature_contract.sd32: rolling population standard deviation ddof=0 over 32 observed bars
common_feature_contract.up_shock: shock and positive body and close location >= 0.8
common_feature_contract.down_shock: shock and negative body and close location <= 0.2

common_execution_and_suppression.fold_crossing_suppression: signal fold differs from exit-boundary bar fold
common_execution_and_suppression.active_suppression: per variant; reject when signal index <= previous accepted exit index; accepted active index becomes i+1+hold_bars
common_execution_and_suppression.missing_data: no bars are synthesized; rolling calculations use observed-bar sequence exactly as old evaluator
common_execution_and_suppression.long_entry: first executable Ask at or after entry boundary
common_execution_and_suppression.short_entry: first executable Bid at or after entry boundary
common_execution_and_suppression.long_exit: first executable Bid at or after exit boundary
common_execution_and_suppression.short_exit: first executable Ask at or after exit boundary

variants.mechanism: A prior 8-hour range boundary is swept intrabar and the completed bar closes back inside the range; enter opposite the sweep.
variants.long_rule: low < prior_low32 and close > prior_low32 and close > open
variants.short_rule: high > prior_high32 and close < prior_high32 and close < open

variants.mechanism: Low directional efficiency and weak EMA separation define balance; a two-standard-deviation close is faded toward the local mean.
An outsized range with a dominant body and extreme close is followed in the shock direction.
At 07:00 UTC continue the 00:00-<07:00 UTC move when net displacement is >=60% of range and close is in outer 20%.
variants.long_rule: prior session efficiency >=0.6 and close position >=0.8
variants.short_rule: prior session efficiency >=0.6 and close position <=0.2

variants.mechanism: At 13:00 UTC continue the 07:00-<13:00 UTC move when net displacement is >=60% of range and close is in outer 20%.
variants.long_rule: prior session efficiency >=0.6 and close position >=0.8
variants.short_rule: prior session efficiency >=0.6 and close position <=0.2

variants.mechanism: At 21:00 UTC continue the 13:00-<21:00 UTC move when net displacement is >=60% of range and close is in outer 20%.
variants.long_rule: prior session efficiency >=0.6 and close position >=0.8
variants.short_rule: prior session efficiency >=0.6 and close position <=0.2

variants.mechanism: A mature EMA-separated trend produces a range expansion that closes through the prior bar in the opposite direction.
variants.long_rule: trend_strength.shift(1) <= -1.5 and TR >=1.25*median_TR96 and close > prior bar high and close > open
variants.short_rule: trend_strength.shift(1) >= 1.5 and TR >=1.25*median_TR96 and close < prior bar low and close < open

variants.mechanism: ATR16/ATR96 shifted one bar is <=0.6 and the completed bar breaks a prior 4-hour range with directional body ratio >=0.5.
variants.long_rule: compression_ratio.shift(1) <=0.6 and close > prior_high16 and close > open and abs(close-open)/(high-low) >=0.5
variants.short_rule: compression_ratio.shift(1) <=0.6 and close < prior_low16 and close < open and abs(close-open)/(high-low) >=0.5

variants.mechanism: A strong trend attempts a new local extreme but closes across EMA20 in the opposite direction.
variants.long_rule: trend_strength.shift(1) <= -1 and low < prior_low16 and close > EMA20 and close > open
variants.short_rule: trend_strength.shift(1) >= 1 and high > prior_high16 and close < EMA20 and close < open

variants.mechanism: Between 08:00 and 12:59 UTC, break the 07:00 UTC bar range with a directional close.
variants.long_rule: hour 08-12 and close > daily 07:00 bar high and close > open
variants.short_rule: hour 08-12 and close < daily 07:00 bar low and close < open

variants.mechanism: Reject the nearest half-yen round level implied by prior close with wick/range ratio >=0.4.
variants.long_rule: low <= lower_level and close > lower_level and lower_wick/(high-low) >=0.4
variants.short_rule: high >= upper_level and close < upper_level and upper_wick/(high-low) >=0.4

variants.mechanism: At 00:00 UTC, follow four-day observed-bar momentum when absolute displacement exceeds ATR96.
variants.long_rule: hour==0 and minute==0 and ATR96 available and momentum_pips >= ATR96
variants.short_rule: hour==0 and minute==0 and ATR96 available and momentum_pips <= -ATR96
